_comment: Makes the sponsor ask season-neutral so it stops soliciting funds for a season that has ended, and drops an unowned recurring promise. Rerun with the new season name once FIRST announces it in September.

sponsors.ctaDescription: Interested in partnering with Solar Flare? Explore our sponsorship tiers to see how your organization can back our upcoming season.

paragraphs: Contributions directly fund robot parts, tools, competition fees, and outreach programs. Every donation or in-kind gift allows us to build higher-performing mechanisms, travel to events, and host workshops for aspiring engineers.
As a fiscally sponsored project of Hack Club, a 501(c)(3), your sponsorship is fully tax-deductible. We can provide a receipt for your records.
